name: Stackable Potions
description: Potions stack in one inventory cell, like keys. Potions you pick up join a stack you already carry.
author: Juan

config.name: Stack size
config.description: The most potions one stack can hold (2 to 511).

config.name: Stack on pickup
config.description: A potion you pick up joins a matching stack in your inventory, like keys.

config.name: Rejuvenation potions
config.description: Rejuvenation and Full Rejuvenation potions stack too.
